topic: Handling overflow calls on the main office line
hook_options: You hear the office line ring twice. Then the hold music starts.
The plumber who answers gets the job. Not the best one.
We hear this a lot: one person in the office can't answer both lines at once.
How many calls go to hold while your office person is already on a call?
Lost calls on hold turn straight into lost revenue.
tweets: You hear the office line ring twice. Then the hold music starts.
Your office manager is deep in dispatch. Another customer hangs up instead of waiting.
That caller dials the next plumbing company on the list and books the water heater replacement.
Pipeline Reception answers your overflow calls when the team is tied up, qualifies the lead, and puts it in your schedule. We can set you up in a day.
caption:
When the main office line backs up, the next call just hangs up.

How do you handle overflow when dispatch gets slammed?
